name: This Is (Not) Danganronpa!
source:
You wake up in the middle of a room, remembering nothing...
You meet people who are in the same situation as you...
Some stuffed mascot tells you that to escape, you need to kill someone and remain undetected...
You promise that neither of you will kill anyone... And then you're immediately in a class trial, where you find out who the killer is, because he decided to hide the murder weapon in a trash can...

[Translated from [url=https://gamejolt.com/games/TINDR/642297]GameJolt[/url]]
translation:
你在房间中央醒来，什么都不记得了……
你会遇到和你处境相同的人…
一些毛绒吉祥物告诉你，要逃脱，你需要杀死某人并且不被发现……
你保证你们俩都不会杀人……然后你立即进入集体审判，你会找出凶手是谁，因为他决定把凶器藏在垃圾桶里……

[译自[url=https://gamejolt.com/games/TINDR/642297]GameJolt[/url]]
